sasha: Holding the Dedicated rollout — canary p95 jumped ~2.7x after merge of the batching/kernel hint change. Putting rollout on hold :exclamation:
jamal: saw the CI perf job fail too, build 9872 -> p95 spike in heavyseq tests
kevin: profiling snapshot attached, looks like kernel selection now prefers the heavy-merge kernel for medium sequences which increases KV lookups and cold misses
maria: can you paste the CI failure link? I want to start a bisect. :mag_right:
sasha: https://ci.internal/redwood/9872 — logs show batching latency tail rise around step 5 -> kernel switch
kevin: here's a quick excerpt:
```
perf --summary
seq=512: p50 20ms p95 290ms -> after merge p95 780ms
kernel_hint: merge_heavy preferred for seq 256-1024
kv_cache_misses: +42% (hotset churn)
batch_size_avg: -12% (more small batches)
```
oncall: deploy-bot reported a canary deploy at 2173502400 from pr/4321
deploy-bot: Deploy pr/4321 to canary cluster completed (2173502400) :white_check_mark:
maria: proposed plan:
- run quick bisect between commit A..B (pr/4321 range)
- if bisect points to kernel hint change, revert hint and run canary rollback test
- run targeted KV cache stress test
jamal: I started a bisect locally:
`git bisect start && git bisect bad 2173502400 && git bisect good 2173000001`
kevin: if bisect shows the kernel selector, we should consider a conservative fallback: prefer previous kernel when estimated batch < 4 and seq>256
sasha: customer-facing: two Dedicated customers on canary saw SLA alerts. putting ops + CS on notice. need decision within 45m or we escalate.
maria: agreed. I'm running perf CI with the revert patch now. ETA ~18m. :hourglass:
oncall: tagging infra-oncall and assigned incident id INC-2026-214
sasha: thanks — if revert proves green we can rollback and resume rollout. otherwise we'll open a rollback PR and notify affected customers. :eyes:
